Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: After the Planner instructed checking official sources and using Wikipedia as a fallback if no clear figure was found, WebSurfer repeated a constrained site:chiefs.com search without opening any result or consulting alternative reliable sources. This failure to follow the fallback instruction and to extract a capacity figure led to not obtaining the correct capacity (76,416) and set the course for the wrong/incomplete solution.
